doc: control_envelope: cycles a warp waits after issuing a BRA before its next issue (redirect / predicate resolution floor on the next dynamic instance, control_floor via InstanceTiming.control_envelope). branch_taken is a converter axis (1 when the warp's next dynamic instance's static pc is not pc + 16, else 0; last instance of a warp = 0). The leaf excludes target instruction fetch (cold lines are charged by instruction.fetch). Measured by control_branch protocol v1: serialized forward branches over 16 B with an early-resolved predicate.
